newsitem.title: JAPAN: Prudential Sec seeks action vs ex-executive - paper.
newsitem.headline: Prudential Sec seeks action vs ex-executive - paper.

text.p: Prudential Securities (Japan) Ltd has asked the Tokyo Metropolitan Police to bring charges against a former company executive suspected of embezzling 2.2 billion yen from the company, a Japanese business daily reported on Thursday.
A company spokesman would not immediately confirm the Nihon Keizai Shimbun report. A police spokesman also said he was unable to confirm the report.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun reported the former executive had been pocketing shares entrusted to the firm by its customers since around 1993.

The former executive is also accused of embezzling settlement money for share trading transactions, the newspaper said. The former executive left the company earlier this year as part of restructuring measures and has admitted the wrongdoings to the company, the Nihon Keizai Shimbun said.

The newspaper also reported that the company has already purchased the equal amount of the missing shares on the market and returned them to customers. The company also said the resulting loss has been covered by insurance, the paper said.
The company is the Tokyo arm of Prudential Securities Inc of the United States.
